(define kv:engine-get (lambda (e k) (if (not (kv:_eng? e))
    (list (kv:get e k) e)
    (let* ((policy (kv:_eng-policy e))
           (body (kv:_eng-body e))
           (index (kv:_eng-index e))
           (cache (kv:_eng-cache e))
           (stats (kv:_eng-stats e))
           (use-c (kv:_want-cache? policy))
           (use-i (kv:_want-index? policy))
           (cv (if use-c (kv:_cache-lookup cache k) #f)))
      ; hits = cache hits only; misses = reads that missed cache (even if body hits)
      (if (not (eq? cv #f))
        (list cv
              (kv:_mk-eng body index
                          (kv:_cache-put cache k cv (kv:_pol-csize policy))
                          (kv:_bump stats 1 0 1 0 0)
                          policy))
        (let* ((ens (kv:_ensure-index body index policy))
               (nindex (car ens))
               (rb (cadr ens))
               (iv (if use-i (kv:_index-lookup nindex k) #f))
               (v (if (not (eq? iv #f)) iv (kv:get body k)))
               (found (not (eq? v #f)))
               (ncache (if (and use-c found)
                         (kv:_cache-put cache k v (kv:_pol-csize policy))
                         cache)))
          (list v
                (kv:_mk-eng body nindex ncache
                            (kv:_bump stats 1 0 0 1 rb)
                            policy))))))))

(define daed:ffi-solve-dense! (lambda (A b n) (let ((res (daed:ffi-blank "init"))
        (nn 0)
        (Ab #f)
        (bb #f)
        (rc -1)
        (disp *daed-ffi-dispatch*))
    (if (not (daed:ffi-proc? disp))
      (daed:ffi-fail "no-bind" "daed_dispatch is not bound" -2 "")
      (if (or (not (number? n)) (<= n 0))
        (daed:ffi-fail "bad-arg" "n must be a positive integer" -2 "")
        (begin
          (set! nn (inexact->exact n))
          (set! Ab (c-alloc (inexact->exact (* nn nn 8))))
          (set! bb (c-alloc (inexact->exact (* nn 8))))
          (if (or (not Ab) (not bb) (number? Ab) (number? bb))
            (daed:ffi-fail "alloc" "c-alloc failed" -2 "")
            (begin
              (daed:pack-f64! Ab A (* nn nn))
              (daed:pack-f64! bb b nn)
              (set! rc
                (try (disp 2

                           (c-opaque->int bb)
                           nn)
                     (catch (e) -1)))
              (hash-set! res "rc" rc)
              (if (= rc 0)
                (begin
                  (daed:unpack-f64! bb b nn)
                  (c-free Ab)
                  (c-free bb)
                  (hash-set! res "ok" #t)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "ok")
                  res)
                (begin
                  (c-free Ab)
                  (c-free bb)
                  (hash-set! res "reason" "solve-fail")
                  (hash-set! res "error" "daed_dispatch op=2 returned non-zero")
                  res))))))))))

(define daed:validate-ir (lambda (ir) (if (not ir)
    (list (daed:issue "error" "no-ir" "circuit" "missing IR" ""))
    (let ((acc '())
          (seen '())
          (has-gnd #f)
          (schema (hash-ref ir "schema" "")))
      (if (and (string? schema)
               (not (equal? schema ""))
               (not (equal? schema daed:ir-schema-id)))
        (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "warn" "schema" "circuit"
                                    "unexpected schema id" "")
                        acc))
        0)
      (let ((cs (daed:ir-comps ir)))
        (if (null? cs)
          (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "empty" "circuit"
                                      "no components" "")
                          acc))
          0)
        (let loop ((xs cs))
          (if (null? xs)
            0
            (begin
              (let ((c (car xs)))
                (let ((ty (hash-ref c "type" ""))
                      (nm (hash-ref c "name" ""))
                      (n1 (daed:node-id (hash-ref c "n1" -1)))
                      (n2 (daed:node-id (hash-ref c "n2" -1)))
                      (val (daed:parse-value (hash-ref c "value" #f))))
                  (if (or (not (string? nm)) (equal? nm ""))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "bad-name" "circuit"
                                                "component missing name" "")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (and (string? nm) (daed:mem-name? nm seen))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "dup-name" nm
                                                "duplicate component name" "rename")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (string? nm)
                    (set! seen (cons nm seen))
                    0)
                  (if (not (daed:type-ok? ty))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "bad-type" nm
                                                "unknown component type" "")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (or (= n1 0) (= n2 0)
                          (and (equal? ty "Q")
                               (= (daed:node-id (hash-ref c "n3" -1)) 0)))
                    (set! has-gnd #t)
                    0)
                  (if (and (daed:passive? ty) (or (not (number? val)) (<= val 0.0)))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "bad-value" nm
                                                "R/C/L must be > 0" "fix-value")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (and (or (equal? ty "D") (equal? ty "Q"))
                           (or (not (number? val)) (<= val 0.0)))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "warn" "bad-is" nm
                                                "Is should be > 0" "fix-value")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (and (or (equal? ty "V") (equal? ty "I"))
                           (not (number? val)))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "bad-value" nm
                                                "source value missing" "fix-value")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (and (equal? ty "V") (= n1 n2))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "v-short" nm
                                                "voltage source is shorted" "unshort-v")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (and (equal? ty "I") (= n1 n2))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "warn" "i-open" nm
                                                "current source terminals coincide" "")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (and (equal? ty "D") (= n1 n2))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "d-short" nm
                                                "diode terminals coincide" "flip-d")
                                    acc))
                    0)))
              (loop (cdr xs)))))
        (if (not has-gnd)
          (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "no-gnd" "circuit"

                          acc))
          0))
      (reverse acc)))))

(define daed:dense-solve! (lambda (A b n) (let ((ok #t)
        (col 0))
    (while (lambda () (and ok (< col n)))
      (lambda ()
        ; partial pivot
        (let ((piv col)
              (best (abs (daed:mat-ref A n col col)))
              (r (+ col 1)))
          (while (lambda () (< r n))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((av (abs (daed:mat-ref A n r col))))
                (if (> av best)
                  (begin (set! best av) (set! piv r))
                  0))
              (set! r (+ r 1))))
          (if (< best 0.000000000001)
            (set! ok #f)
            (begin
              (daed:swap-rows! A b n col piv)
              ; eliminate below
              (let ((i (+ col 1)))
                (while (lambda () (< i n))
                  (lambda ()
                    (let ((diag (daed:mat-ref A n col col)))
                      (let ((factor (daed:safe-div (daed:mat-ref A n i col) diag)))
                        (daed:mat-set! A n i col 0.0)
                        (let ((j (+ col 1)))
                          (while (lambda () (< j n))
                            (lambda ()
                              (daed:mat-set! A n i j
                                (- (daed:mat-ref A n i j)
                                   (* factor (daed:mat-ref A n col j))))
                              (set! j (+ j 1)))))
                        (daed:vec-set! b i
                          (- (daed:vec-ref b i)
                             (* factor (daed:vec-ref b col))))))
                    (set! i (+ i 1))))))))
        (set! col (+ col 1))))
    (if (not ok)
      #f
      (begin
        ; back substitution
        (let ((i (- n 1)))
          (while (lambda () (and ok (>= i 0)))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((s (daed:vec-ref b i))
                    (j (+ i 1)))
                (while (lambda () (< j n))
                  (lambda ()
                    (set! s (- s (* (daed:mat-ref A n i j)
                                    (daed:vec-ref b j))))
                    (set! j (+ j 1))))
                (let ((diag (daed:mat-ref A n i i)))
                  (if (< (abs diag) 0.000000000001)
                    (set! ok #f)
                    (daed:vec-set! b i (daed:safe-div s diag)))))
              (set! i (- i 1)))))
        ok)))))
(define daed:simulate-op (lambda (ckt) (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (let ((sys (daed:stamp-system comps)))
      (let ((N (car sys))
            (A (car (cdr sys)))
            (b (car (cdr (cdr sys))))
            (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr sys))))))
        (let ((res (hash)))
          (hash-set! res "n" N)
          (hash-set! res "n_v" n-v)
          (if (<= N 0)
            (begin
              (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
              (hash-set! res "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
              (hash-set! res "volts" (hash))
              res)
            (let ((ok (daed:dense-solve! A b N)))
              (hash-set! res "ok" ok)
              (hash-set! res "x" b)
              (let ((volts (hash)))
                (hash-set! volts "0" 0.0)
                (if ok

                    (while (lambda () (<= k n-v))
                      (lambda ()
                        (hash-set! volts
                                   (number->string k)
                                   (daed:vec-ref b (- k 1)))
                        (set! k (+ k 1)))))
                  0)
                (hash-set! res "volts" volts)
                res)))))))))

(define prom:execute-proposal (lambda (proposal sample-arg n-leaves) (if (not (prom:proposal-valid? proposal))
    (list (cons ":ok" #f)
          (cons ":decision" 'refuse)
          (cons ":reason" "schema-invalid")
          (cons ":errors" (prom:proposal-errors proposal))
          (cons ":snap" -1)
          (cons ":got" -1)
          (cons ":want" -1)
          (cons ":source" (try (prom:proposal-source proposal) (catch (e) "?"))))
    (let ((kind (prom:proposal-kind proposal))
          (src (prom:proposal-source proposal)))
      (if (equal? kind "skip")
        (list (cons ":ok" #t)
              (cons ":decision" 'skip)
              (cons ":reason" "no-mutate")
              (cons ":snap" -1)
              (cons ":got" (prom:sample-subject sample-arg))
              (cons ":want" -1)
              (cons ":source" src))
        (let* ((body (prom:proposal-body proposal))
               (want (prom:want-for-body body sample-arg))
               (summary (prom:proposal-summary proposal))
               (r (prom:rebind-live "subject" body summary sample-arg))
               (got (prom:alist-ref ":got" r -1))
               (leaves (prom:leaves-intact? n-leaves))
               (applied (eq? (prom:alist-ref ":ok" r #f) #t))
               (good (and applied (= got want) leaves)))
          (if good
            (begin
              (prom:stats-bump! "correctness_ok")
              (list (cons ":ok" #t)
                    (cons ":decision" 'commit)
                    (cons ":reason" "verified")
                    (cons ":snap" -1)
                    (cons ":got" got)
                    (cons ":want" want)
                    (cons ":source" src)
                    (cons ":leaves_ok" leaves)))
            (begin
              (prom:stats-bump! "correctness_fail")
              (list (cons ":ok" #f)
                    (cons ":decision" 'rollback)
                    (cons ":reason" (if applied "verify-failed" "rebind-failed"))
                    (cons ":snap" -1)
                    (cons ":got" got)
                    (cons ":want" want)
                    (cons ":source" src)
                    (cons ":leaves_ok" leaves))))))))))

  ;;    "unbound" of a notebook define (aura#4363) is not turned into a

(define pad:hl-tokens (lambda (s) (let ((n (string-length s)))
    (let loop ((i 0) (acc (list)))
      (if (>= i n)
          (reverse acc)
          (let* ((t (pad:hl-one s i n))
                 (k (car t))
                 (a (pad:hl-nth t 1))
                 (b (pad:hl-nth t 2))
                 (ni (pad:hl-nth t 3)))
            (if (not k)
                (reverse acc)
                (if (string=? k ".")
                    (loop ni acc)
                    (loop ni
                          (cons (list k a b (substring s a b)) acc))))))))))

(define pad:pi-bytes! (lambda (line) (set! *pi-slow* (+ *pi-slow* 1))
  (let ((bs (pad:pi-parse line)))
    (if (not bs)
        (begin
          (pad:play-reject! "unknown")
          (if *pi-collect* (set! *pi-out* (cons (pad:play-snap) *pi-out*)) (display (pad:play-snap)))
          "go")
        (let pi-each ((xs bs))
          (if (null? xs)
              "go"
              (let* ((b (car xs))
                     (r (if (and (= b 15) (null? *pl-esc*))
                            (pad:who-key!)
                            (let ((step (pad:key-step *pl-esc* b)))
                              (set! *pl-esc* (car (cdr step)))
                              (if (and (string? (car step)) (string=? (car step) "pending"))
                                  "pending"
                                  (pad:play-cmd! (car step)))))))
                (cond
                  ((string=? r "quit") "quit")
                  ((string=? r "pending") (pi-each (cdr xs)))
                  (#t
                   (if *pi-collect* (set! *pi-out* (cons (pad:play-snap) *pi-out*)) (display (pad:play-snap)))
                   (pi-each (cdr xs)))))))))))

(define pd:goal-propose-body! (lambda (body) (let ((clean (pd:clean body)))
    (set! *goal-word* "")
    (set! *goal-why* "")
    (let ((why (pd:goal-body-why clean)))
      (cond
        ((string=? why "gate")
         (set! *goal-word* (pd:goal-bad-word clean))
         (if (= (string-length *goal-word*) 0)
             (set! *goal-word* (pd:goal-cap-word clean)))
         (pd:gate-reject! "gate" *goal-word*)
         (pd:goal-out! "goal_reject"))
        ((string=? why "kind")
         (set! *goal-word* (pad:mean-word-goal clean))
         (display "GATE reject reason=kind word=")
         (display *goal-word*)
         (display " say=\"let us use kind words\"")
         (newline)
         (pd:goal-out! "goal_reject"))
        ((string=? why "not-allowed")
         (set! *goal-word* (pd:goal-cap-word clean))
         (display "REJECT mid=8 reason=not-allowed cmd=goal word=")
         (display *goal-word*)
         (display " say=\"")
         (display (pad:card-kid "not-allowed"))
         (display "\"")
         (newline)
         (pd:goal-out! "goal_reject"))
        (#t
         (let ((sw (hot-strategy:swap! "pd:goal" clean "goal-propose")))
           (if (not (and (pair? sw) (equal? (car sw) #t)))
               (begin
                 (pd:gate-reject! "swap" "")
                 (pd:goal-out! "goal_reject"))
               (let ((pwhy (pad:plan-check (try (pd:goal) (catch (e) #f)))))
                 (if (not (string=? pwhy "ok"))
                     (begin
                       (set! *goal-why* pwhy)

                       (display "HEAL name=pd:goal reason=probe why=")
                       (display pwhy)
                       (newline)
                       (pd:goal-out! "goal_heal"))
                     (begin

                       (newline)
                       (pd:goal-race! clean))))))))))))

(define pad:world-race! (lambda (who tries goal) (if *robot-pending* (pad:robot-drop!) #f)
  (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
  (set! *world-races* (+ *world-races* 1))
  (let* ((L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (code0 (pad:q-code))
         (snap (ast:snapshot "world"))
         (base (pad:world-score goal))
         (ts (pad:world-run-all who tries goal code0 snap 1))
         (same (and (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0) (string=? (pad:q-code) code0)))
         (ideas-ok (pad:world-ideas-ok? ts))
         (win (pad:world-best ts base #f))
         (n (length goal))
         (k (pad:world-keep! who win)))
    (let* ((keep-ok (or (not win)
                        (and (string=? (car k) "KEEP")
                             (string=? (pad:q-code) (pad:nth win 5))
                             (= (pad:world-score goal) (pad:nth win 2)))))
           (v (if (and same ideas-ok keep-ok) "agree" "disagree"))
           (say (cond
                  ((not win)
                   (string-append "the " who " tried " (number->string (length ts))
                                  " ideas in its own worlds, none did better than your page ("
                                  (pad:world-n-of base n) " checks), nothing changed"))
                  ((not (string=? (car k) "KEEP")) (pad:nth k 2))

(define pad:nth (lambda (xs i) (if (= i 0) (car xs) (pad:nth (cdr xs) (- i 1)))))
(define pad:lgate (lambda (c L l col) (let* ((n (length L))
         (ln (pad:nth L l))
         (len (length ln))
         (empty (and (= n 1) (= len 0))))
    (cond
      ((number? c)
       (cond
         ((not (or (= c 32) (and (>= c 97) (<= c 122)))) "not-print")
         ((>= len *max-col*) "need-space")
         (#t "ok")))
      ((not (string? c)) "not-a-key")
      ((not (pad:str-in? c *line-cmds*)) "not-a-key")
      ((and (string=? c "left") (= l 0) (= col 0)) "too-far")
      ((and (string=? c "right") (= l (- n 1)) (>= col len)) "too-far")
      ((and (string=? c "next-line") (>= l (- n 1))) "no-line")
      ((and (string=? c "prev-line") (= l 0)) "no-line")
      ((and (string=? c "back") empty) "empty-buf")
      ((and (string=? c "back") (= l 0) (= col 0)) "too-far")
      ((and (string=? c "kill-line") empty) "empty-buf")
      ((and (string=? c "kill-line") (>= col len) (>= l (- n 1))) "no-line")
      ((and (string=? c "open-line") (>= n *max-lines*)) "need-space")
      (#t "ok")))))
(define pad:lapply (lambda (c L l col) (let* ((ln (pad:nth L l))
         (len (length ln)))
    (cond
      ((number? c)
       (list (pad:put-nth L l (pad:insert ln col c)) l (+ col 1)))
      ((string=? c "left")
       (if (> col 0)
           (list L l (- col 1))
           (list L (- l 1) (length (pad:nth L (- l 1))))))
      ((string=? c "right")
       (if (< col len)
           (list L l (+ col 1))
           (list L (+ l 1) 0)))
      ((string=? c "home") (list L l 0))
      ((string=? c "end") (list L l len))
      ((string=? c "next-line")
       (let ((nl (length (pad:nth L (+ l 1)))))
         (list L (+ l 1) (if (> col nl) nl col))))
      ((string=? c "prev-line")
       (let ((pl (length (pad:nth L (- l 1)))))
         (list L (- l 1) (if (> col pl) pl col))))
      ((string=? c "back")
       (if (> col 0)
           (list (pad:put-nth L l (pad:delete-back ln col)) l (- col 1))
           (let* ((pv (pad:nth L (- l 1)))
                  (pl (length pv)))
             (list (pad:del-nth (pad:put-nth L (- l 1) (append pv ln)) l)
                   (- l 1)
                   pl))))
      ((string=? c "kill-line")
       (if (< col len)
           (list (pad:put-nth L l (pad:take col ln)) l col)
           (list (pad:del-nth (pad:put-nth L l (append ln (pad:nth L (+ l 1))))
                              (+ l 1))
                 l
                 col)))
      ((string=? c "open-line")
       (list (pad:ins-nth (pad:put-nth L l (pad:take col ln))
                          (+ l 1)
                          (pad:drop col ln))
             l
             col))
      (#t (list L l col))))))

(define prove-or-refuse (lambda (cycles pressure) (let ((bin (env-get "AURA_BIN" "")))
    (if (equal? bin "")
      (let ((r (empty-report "aura_binary_missing")))
        (hash-set! r "cycles_requested" cycles)
        (hash-set! r "worldline_pressure" pressure)
        (apply-fiber-probe r (fiber-probe-skipped "aura_binary_missing"))
        r)
      (let loop ((i 0) (storm (list)) (ok-n 0) (incr-n 0))
        (if (>= i cycles)
          (let* ((proven (and (= ok-n cycles) (= incr-n cycles) (> cycles 0)))
                 (reason (if proven "storm_incr_valid_measured"
                           (if (= ok-n cycles) "incr_valid_incomplete" "storm_cycles_failed")))
                 (r (empty-report reason)))
            (hash-set! r "measured" #t)
            (hash-set! r "aura_healthy" #t)
            (hash-set! r "incr_proven" proven)
            (hash-set! r "cycles_requested" cycles)
            (hash-set! r "cycles_completed" cycles)
            (hash-set! r "cycles_ok" ok-n)
            (hash-set! r "cycles_incr_valid" incr-n)
            (hash-set! r "worldline_pressure" pressure)
            (hash-set! r "storm" (reverse storm))
            (apply-fiber-probe r (probe-fiber-session))
            r)
          (let* ((pr (pressure-cycles i pressure))
                 (storm2 (append (car pr) storm))
                 (ok-n2 (if (car (cdr pr)) (+ ok-n 1) ok-n))
                 (incr-n2 (if (and (car (cdr pr)) (car (cdr (cdr pr)))) (+ incr-n 1) incr-n)))
            (loop (+ i 1) storm2 ok-n2 incr-n2))))))))

(define observe-gate (lambda (sample-bundle prev-bundle accuracy-ok) ; correctness gates from Aura query faces; accuracy-ok from host/Soft feedback.
  (let* ((samples (hash-ref sample-bundle "samples" (list)))
         (prev-samples (if (hash? prev-bundle)
                         (hash-ref prev-bundle "samples" (list))
                         (list)))
         (rel (observe-find-sample samples "query:incremental-relower-stats"))
         (prev-rel (observe-find-sample prev-samples "query:incremental-relower-stats"))
         (cas (observe-find-sample samples "query:dirty-cascade-stats"))
         (prev-cas (observe-find-sample prev-samples "query:dirty-cascade-stats"))
         (soa (observe-find-sample samples "query:soa-dirty-stats"))
         (prev-soa (observe-find-sample prev-samples "query:soa-dirty-stats"))
         (tl (observe-find-sample samples "query:type-linear-commit-health"))
         (mh (observe-find-sample samples "query:mutation-hold-live"))
         (ps (observe-find-sample samples "query:post-steal-closed-loop-stats"))
         (d-force (observe-delta rel prev-rel "partial_forced_full_by_impact_total"))
         (d-cold (observe-delta rel prev-rel "incremental_relower_cold_miss_total"))
         (d-parity (observe-delta cas prev-cas "dual-dep-graph-parity-fail-total"))
         (d-soa-ff (observe-delta soa prev-soa "soa-dirty-desync-force-full-total"))
         (force-abs (observe-pos (hash-ref rel "partial_forced_full_by_impact_total" 0)))
         (cold-abs (observe-pos (hash-ref rel "incremental_relower_cold_miss_total" 0)))
         (parity-abs (observe-pos (hash-ref cas "dual-dep-graph-parity-fail-total" 0)))
         (soa-ff-abs (observe-pos (hash-ref soa "soa-dirty-desync-force-full-total" 0)))
         (ready-bp (hash-ref tl "readiness-bp" -1))
         (ready-red (and (number? ready-bp) (>= ready-bp 0) (< ready-bp 5000)))
         (hold-red (or (> (observe-pos (hash-ref mh "over-budget" 0)) 0)
                       (> (observe-pos (hash-ref mh "live-over-budget-observe-total" 0)) 0)))
         (steal-red (> (observe-pos (hash-ref ps "post_steal_linear_hard_fail_total" 0)) 0))
         ; Rising force-full / cold-miss / parity / soa force-full ⇒ red.
         ; Absolute parity/soa-ff/steal hard-fail also red (correctness).
         (storm-red (or (> d-force 0) (> d-cold 0) (> d-parity 0) (> d-soa-ff 0)
                        (> parity-abs 0) (> soa-ff-abs 0) ready-red hold-red steal-red))
         (acc-ok (if (boolean? accuracy-ok) accuracy-ok #t))
         (gate (cond
                 ((not acc-ok) "red")
                 (storm-red "red")
                 ; amber: lifetime force-full present but not rising this sample
                 ((or (> force-abs 0) (> cold-abs 0)) "amber")
                 (#t "green")))
         (reasons (list)))
    (if (not acc-ok)
      (set! reasons (cons "accuracy_red" reasons))
      #t)
    (if (> d-force 0)
      (set! reasons (cons "force_full_rising" reasons))
      #t)

(define workspace-create (lambda (root n) (ensure-dir root)
  (ensure-dir (join-path root "parent"))
  (write-file (join-path root "parent" "SNAPSHOT") "parent_id=wl-parent\n")
  (ensure-dir (join-path root "candidates"))
  (let loop ((i 0) (cands (hash)) (cand-meta (hash)))
    (if (>= i n)
      (let* ((ws (hash "root" root
                       "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
                       "session_model" SESSION_SHARED
                       "candidates" cands
                       "n" n))
             (meta (hash "episode_token" (make-id)
                         "session_model" SESSION_SHARED
                         "parent" (hash "ref_id" "wl-parent"
                                        "parent_ref" #f
                                        "workspace_relpath" "parent"
                                        "kind" "parent")
                         "candidates" cand-meta
                         "discarded" (list)
                         "incr_proven" #f
                         "fiber_live" #f
                         "honesty" "shared workspace + stable refs; not fiber-live")))
        (write-file (join-path root "meta.json")
                    (normalize-json-empties (json-encode meta)))
        ws)
      (let* ((cid (string-append "wl-" (number->string i)))
             (rel (string-append "candidates/" cid))
             (cdir (join-path root rel)))
        (ensure-dir cdir)
        (write-file (join-path cdir "REF")
                    (string-append "ref_id=" cid "\nparent_ref=wl-parent\n"))
        (hash-set! cands cid cid)
        (hash-set! cand-meta cid
                   (hash "ref_id" cid
                         "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
                         "workspace_relpath" rel

         (n (ncols grid)))
    (let ((dp (make-list m '())))
      (letrec (
        ;; Fill row i from right to left; row-below is (list-ref dp (+ i 1)) or #f
        (fill-row (lambda (i)
          (letrec ((row-below (if (< i (- m 1)) (list-ref dp (+ i 1)) #f))
                   (loop (lambda (j)
                     (if (< j 0) '()
                         (let* ((val (cell grid i j))
                                (right (if (< j (- n 1))
                                           (car (list-ref (list-ref dp i) 1))
                                           #f))
                                (down (if row-below
                                          (list-ref row-below j)
                                          #f))
                                (next (cond
                                         ((and (number? right) (number? down))
                                          (min right down))
                                         ((number? right) right)
                                         ((number? down) down)

  ;; Walks from top-right corner in O(m+n).
  (let ((rows (length grid))
        (cols (if (null? grid) 0 (length (car grid))))

        ((or (>= r rows) (< c 0)) cnt)
        (else
         (let ((val (list-ref (list-ref grid r) c)))

               (loop r (- c 1) cnt)))))))))
